case.title: Fabricator echoes the form's source later in the voice note, but an earlier keyword names a different source

submissions.open_text: Pressure drops every evening so we store water in drums.
submissions.voice_transcript: We carry it from the stream every morning, there is no pipe here yet.

submissions.open_text: Neighbours complain that kiosk queues are long on weekends.

case.why: The earliest keyword in the transcript is 'stream' (river); 'pipe' (piped_home) comes later. River differs from the form's piped_home, so the check fires. An implementation that stays silent whenever any keyword in the transcript matches the form, or that uses the last keyword, would be fooled by a fabricator who tacks the form's source onto the end of the voice note. The companion has no voice note, and its open_text shares no content words with the target's.
